messages:
isabel: idea  run a 12-day "Community Refkit Labs" focused on messaging iteration + reproducible benchmarks. mix of 4 tutorials, a lightweight refapp template, and a judged leaderboard. KPI: 80 signups, 60 bench submissions, 40 engaged devs.
tony: love the messaging iteration angle. propose we test 3 headline ropes: product (latency/cost), maker (ship small refapp), and learning (tutorial-first). split traffic 33/33/34 via utm.
farah: for the benchmark rubric: require `results.json` with {user, model, seq_len, tokens, p95_ms}. provide a sample Gist and a short `parse_results.sh` to normalize.
li: leadflow: HubSpot form fields = name|email|github|company|use_case|bench_url|utm_campaign|headline_variant. tag leads `refkit_labs_1718`. then push to SFDC as `community_lab` record type.
nora: community ops: we'll create #refkit-labs on slack and a Discord thread; host two office hours. also seed developer ambassadors with microgrants ($200 dev credit + sticker pack) to create example refapps.
farah: benchmark narrative plan: canonical blog post that aggregates results + calls out 3 interesting optimizations we observed. also short 'what we learned' bullets for social cards.
ton y: infra: repo template with `/starter-refapp`, `/bench/run_bench.py`, `/docs/tutorials/01-04.md`. add `--cpu` flag and `--output results.json`. GH Action: on push run smoke bench and update `/bench/ci-summary.json`.
isabel: marketing asks: 1) landing page + signups, 2) canonical blog + benchmark narrative, 3) 4 short tutorials, 4) webinar (live demo + panel), 5) ambassador highlights. owners: isabel=launch, tony=repo, farah=bench scripts & narrative, li=lead routing, nora=community.
li: form embed snippet for landing: `<form action="https://lp.redwood.ai/refkit-labs/submit" method="post"><input name="email"/><input name="github"/><input type="hidden" name="utm_campaign" value="refkit_labs_1718"/><button>Join</button></form>`
nora: social plan: 8 posts + two influencer DMs. creatives: hero gif (refapp boot), three variant social cards aligned to headline variants. will deliver assets by Wed EOD.
farah: A/B messaging details: track headline_variant in HubSpot and GA. We'll measure click->signup->bench_submit conversion for each. decide winner by day 6 and amplify.
ton y: leaderboard rules: valid submission = gist URL or hosted `results.json` + repo star. judge picks top 5 for shoutouts; winners get microgrant and featured blog callout.
isabel: webinar timing: live demo + 20m panel featuring two ambassadors + live bench run. schedule Wed 1718230000 (evening NA friendly).
press-bot: Note: Prep one-sheeter for press outreach after day 8; outreach window day 9-12.
li: analytics: utm_campaign=refkit_labs_1718; build funnels in GA and HubSpot. create cohort for bench_submitters and tag as `lab_submitter`.
farah: quick code for results schema in docs: ```json
{"user":"alice","model":"redwood-1.5b","seq_len":512,"tokens":512,"p95_ms":85}
```
notebook example and a small colab link will be included.
nora: community support: volunteer mentors list + office hours schedule. also small badge image for GitHub READMEs.
isabel: deadlines: repo + starter PR by Tue EOD, landing draft Wed AM, social assets Wed EOD, blog draft by day 5. final sync Fri 9am PT. tiny updates only in this thread. :sparkles:
ton y: I'll PR the starter-refapp and GH Action now.
li: I'll wire HubSpot mapping and create the `refkit_labs_1718` list by Thurs.
farah: drafting benchmark narrative outline tonight.
press-bot: Event created: Webinar "Refkit Labs: Build & Measure" at 1718230000. Calendar invites to @marketing @devrel.
